d: Replaces the Addon Manager with the Addon Marketplace: clickable filter lozenges, Update and Downgrade buttons, and a project dialog that tests web and local addon repositories. To switch it off, hide this plugin and restart Gramps.
Erzeugt einen vollständigen Bericht über die ausgewählten Personen, sortiert nach Nachname, Vorname und Geburtsdatum
Beta Gramplet suggesting items to research
Adds Clip items to the clipboard right-click menu: the object a reference row points to, and all the places enclosing a place.
Key in a relative of the active person, with their birth, death and other events and sources, on one form instead of working through a dozen editing dialogs
Resizable Attribute Editor with a multi-line Value field, plus multi-column type popups and 'Add a gramplet' menus (sidebar, bottombar and Dashboard monkey patch).

Developer reference gramplet showing the current locale, the related locale settings and where each is set, a searchable, sortable table of all Gramps string constants, and a preview of other Gramps translations.
Packaging and distribution tool - create release-ready Gramps addon plugin packages and listings for GitHub publishing

Library for other addons: phonetic surname matching (fuzzy_match_index.py), person-display formatting (fuzzy_match_display.py), and a standalone lookup window (FuzzyMatchLookupWindow.py) for a quick 'does someone like this already exist' check from another plugin. See FuzzyMatchAPI.md in this addon's own folder for the calling convention.
Gramplet for finding people in the Family Tree whose surname phonetically matches a given surname, using a cached per-tree index so it stays fast on large Family Trees
Makes Family Trees > Import... work when no Family Tree is loaded. A new Family Tree is created, named after the imported file, and the file is imported into it.
Shared Markdown rendering and icon-resolution library used by Markdown Dash, Plugin Manager plus, and other addons. Not a tool or gramplet itself -- installed so those addons can import it.
On startup, offers to import a practice Family Tree from the sample data included with Gramps. Afterwards it shows the Dashboard with a To Do note to get started. Field-test port of Gramps PR 2388.

Improves the New/Edit Person dialogs: Multiple Surnames column widths are remembered (Gramps PR 2485), switching to Multiple Surnames adds a row ready for typing, a Fuzzy Match Lookup button appears beside the Surname field when Fuzzy Matching is installed, and the Surname field shows a 'surname' tip.
Laufzeit-Patch, der Erweiterungen in mehr Sprachen funktionieren lässt. Erweiterungen werden auch ohne Übersetzung für Ihre Sprache geladen, und ihre eigenen Übersetzungen haben Vorrang.

On systems with PyGObject 3.56 or newer, prevents crashes such as the Place Details gramplet 'Must be string' error, and stops a small memory leak when editing table cells in editors. Does nothing on older systems.
Replaces the Close button of gramplets undocked from a sidebar or bottombar with a Dock button, and uses the smart Help button of Markdown Utils when that addon is active.
